newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco arrests three Europeans on drug charges.
newsitem.headline: Morocco arrests three Europeans on drug charges.

text.p: Morocco has arrested three Europeans and a Dutch-based Moroccan expatriate on charges of smuggling drugs to Europe, a semi-official newspaper said on Monday.

Le Matin du Sahara newspaper showed pictures of the four, named as 53-year-old Frenchman Claude Joseph Levique, Spaniard Molina Parra Yolanda, 37, Dutchman Silva Almedia and Moroccan Mohamed Agourram.
Levique and Yolanda were arrested at a northern border post as they tried to smuggle 164 kg (360 pounds) of cannabis hidden in their car registered in France, the newspaper said.
Agourram and Almedia were arrested in nearby Nador port with 38.8 kg (85 pounds) while bound for the Netherlands, it said.
The four will be tried soon, the newspaper said. If found guilty, they face up to 10 years in jail.

Morocco last year arrested more than 18,000 drug-runners, including 342 foreigners -- mostly Europeans -- according to Interior Minister Driss Basri, quoted by the official Moroccan news agency earlier this month.
